object_description: two offset school buildings linked by a base wing
design_condition: Two offset buildings are positioned at right angles to the existing civic building, connected through a base wing and carefully stepped across different ground-floor heights to form graduated public and private outdoor sequences.

positive.statement: The project is seamlessly embedded in the district through a sensitive urban arrangement and a public outdoor space that feeds into the neighborhood.

position.rationale: Open space is inferred around the clearly separated building masses and central connection.

positive.statement: The central break area cleverly combines the needs of the primary school and day school while connecting the school buildings and gymnasium.

position.rationale: The central gap between offset blocks is the clearest visible break and connector zone.

positive.statement: The split-level organization subtly anchors the school in the site and creates unusual visual qualities.

position.rationale: Offset masses and multiple horizontal elevation bands visibly indicate stepped organization.

positive.statement: The central hall and multifunctional music hall create a well-considered gesture toward the neighborhood.

position.target: central hall and multifunctional music hall
position.rationale: Named interior halls are not distinguishable; the central connector provides the most useful anchor.

positive.statement: The project handles the different ground-floor heights sensitively and creates a desired gradation in the publicity of outdoor spaces.

position.rationale: Stepped lower bands support an approximate outdoor sequence beside the offset masses.

positive.statement: The two school buildings are precisely thought out and promise a well-functioning overall system.

position.rationale: Two distinct offset rectangular volumes are unmistakable in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The project performs well in energy efficiency through moderate spans, linear load transfer and coherent technical planning.

position.rationale: Structural performance is global, but the compact building masses provide a representative anchor.

positive.statement: The construction costs fall within the middle range.

position.rationale: Cost-range judgment has no useful spatial referent.

negative.statement: Access by ramps does not yet work.

position.rationale: Ramps are not distinguishable; the lower front approach is the plausible access anchor.

negative.statement: The spatial richness and innovation of the primary-school section are not carried through to the core school and group-room typology.

position.rationale: Interior typology is not visible, so the larger offset block is used as a constrained proxy.

negative.statement: The open central area creates a very large space that is sensitive in terms of acoustics.

position.rationale: The substantial gap between masses is clearly visible and anchors the acoustic concern.

negative.statement: The longitudinal classroom arrangement does not create flexible spaces for different forms of collaboration.

position.rationale: Classroom arrangement is interior; the long upper-left block provides a directional proxy.

negative.statement: The basic-level building remains one-sided, and the quality of the upper-floor classrooms is not equally convincing.

position.rationale: Ground-level concern is anchored to the lower offset building and lowest elevation bands.

negative.statement: The central toilet arrangement is unconvincing and storage options for school supplies are missing.

position.rationale: Toilets and storage are interior; the central connection is the least speculative anchor.

negative.statement: The caretaker's apartment appears unattractive because of its central, exposed location.

position.rationale: The apartment is not identifiable; its stated central exposure constrains the connector area.

negative.statement: The complex roof landscape results in rather poor compactness.

position.rationale: Multiple distinct upper profiles and stepped horizontal bands visibly indicate complex roofs.

negative.statement: The project does not fully fulfill its promise as a typological contribution to contemporary teaching.

position.rationale: The whole arrangement is spatially relevant, represented by the offset building system.
